lexical_split.left: 🔴 PANEL 6C GIVES THE OTHER HALF, AND THE SIZE OF THE FLIP. In isolated calvarial osteoblasts the KO values relative to WT are Alp 0.655, Bsp 0.375, ColI 0.225, Oc 0.225 and RUNX2 0.295 — a 70% fall. So the SAME GENE in the SAME KNOCKOUT reads +50% in femur tissue and −70% in isolated osteoblasts from the same animals' calvaria. INFERENZA: this is a tissue-versus-cell-autonomous split, not a contradiction in the data. In bone the measurement includes recruitment — more osteoprogenitors entering the lineage to compensate for resorptive loss — while the isolated culture removes that systemic input and exposes the cell-intrinsic deficit. 🔴 THE CONSTRAINT THIS PLACES ON TRACK C, WRITTEN AS A CONSTRAINT AND NOT AS AN OBSERVATION: A NODE WHOSE SIGN CHANGES BETWEEN TISSUE AND ISOLATED CELL CANNOT CARRY A REPURPOSING HYPOTHESIS. Track C
lexical_split.right: a signed pathway direction before a node opens; RUNX2 downstream of WWOX has no single sign, it has one sign per preparation, and any agent chosen to push it would push it the wrong way in one of the two. This is the same shape as the confound found in PMID 26675548, where a metabolic signature and a differentiation defect were measured on one readout.

evidence.anchor: Figure 3, all five ITC panels; image retrieved from the CDN path embedded in the article HTML and held gitignored
evidence.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 3, five paired panels a-e. Upper panels: raw thermal power against time over roughly 80 minutes, showing injection spikes. Lower panels: molar heat against molar ratio from 0 to about 7.5, fitted with a solid line. Panels a (WBP1_PY1), c (WBP2_PY1) and d (WBP2_PY2) show near-horizontal traces between about −0.9 and −0.4 kcal/mol with no sigmoidal shape and shallow injection spikes. Panel b (WBP1_PY2) descends from about −1.9 to −0.6 kcal/mol, still curving at the highest molar ratio. Panel e (WBP2_PY3) descends from about −3.1 to −0.5 kcal/mol, also still curving at the highest molar ratio, with the deepest injection spikes of the set reaching about −2 μcal/s.

lexical_split.left: 🔴 THE ITC ISOTHERMS DO NOT REACH SATURATION, WHICH QUALIFIES EVERY NUMBER IN TABLES 1 AND 5 AND IS INVISIBLE IN THE TEXT. This is the panel finding the figure waiver cost, and it is exactly the residual risk that waiver named. THE THREE NBD PANELS ARE HONEST: WBP1_PY1, WBP2_PY1 and WBP2_PY2 give essentially flat heat traces, so 'no binding detected' is what the raw data show rather than a fitting choice. BUT THE TWO BINDING PANELS ARE SHALLOW: WBP1_PY2 runs from about −1.9 to −0.6 kcal/mol and WBP2_PY3 from about −3.1 to −0.5, and NEITHER HAS FLATTENED at the highest molar ratio shown, about 7.5. A titration that has not saturated is a low-c experiment in the Wiseman sense, and in that regime the fitted stoichiometry and the dissociation constant are correlated and weakly determined. 🔴 AND THE LOW-c DIAGNOSIS MUST NOT REST ON CURVE SHAPE ALONE — IT IS ARITHMETIC FROM THE PAPER'S OWN METHODS. The Methods state 25 × 10 μl injections of 2-4 mM peptide into 1.8 ml of 100-200 μM WW domain at 25 °C, so for a 1:1 interaction c = [domain]/Kd falls in a RANGE rather than at a point, because the concentration used in any single titration is not reported: WW1 alone with WBP1_PY2 (366 μM) gives c ≈ 0.27-0.55; WW1 alone with WBP2_PY3 (122 μM) gives c ≈ 0.82-1.64. Both are at or below the threshold where an isotherm is informative about stoichiometry. THE TANDEM MEASUREMENTS ARE BETTER PLACED AND THIS CUTS IN THEIR FAVOUR: the WT tandem with WBP2_PY3 (49 μM) gives c ≈ 2.04-4.08, and the engineered WW1-WW2rw with WBP2_PY3 (59 μM) gives c ≈ 1.69-3.39 — low, but not the regime where n is unrecoverable. The remaining tandem titrations sit lower: WT with WBP1_PY2 (132 μM) c ≈ 0.76-1.52 and with WBP2_PY2 (326 μM) c ≈ 0.31-0.61. CONSEQUENCE, STATED AS THE OPERATOR
lexical_split.right: the ±1 μM on a 122 μM Kd is the scatter of three fits and not the accuracy of the determination. AND THE ENGINEERED CONTROL DOES NOT 'PROTECT' n = 1.05 NOR DEMONSTRATE ITS ACCURACY ON ITS OWN — it CORROBORATES that the fit can discriminate one binding capacity from two under comparable conditions, which is a weaker and correct statement.

evidence.anchor: Results and Discussion, describing the alanine scan of Table 2
evidence.snippet: rendering the PXPPXYY motif the optimal consensus sequence for binding to the WW1 domain of WWOX

lexical_split.left: THE RECOGNITION REQUIREMENT IS LONGER THAN PPXY IN THIS PEPTIDE PANEL. Alanine scanning across WBP2_PY3 shows proline at −2 and tyrosine at +4
lexical_split.right: HIGH-AFFINITY binding, and the authors define PXPPXYY as the OPTIMAL CONSENSUS SEQUENCE for WWOX's WW1 — a statement about the panel they tested, NOT a universal consensus, and my earlier phrase 'the true consensus' overstated it. The authors also state the qualifier explicitly: absence of the extended positions REDUCES affinity without necessarily abolishing binding, which is why WBP1_PY2 binds at 366 μM despite lacking both. THE METHODOLOGICAL CONCLUSION SURVIVES THE NARROWING AND IS THE PART THAT MATTERS HERE: a PPXY proteome scan generates too many candidates and is not an inventory of partners — demonstrated in this paper, where three of five PPXY motifs in two genuine adaptors are not bound at all.

PROPOSE -> CONCLUDE is the seam epistemic_discipline.md and scientist_reading_modes.md 6.2 name — an author's hypothesis reported as an observation — and here the upgrade was performed by the SAME PERSON, single-authoring the introduction that summarised his own chapter.

lexical_split.left: THE THIRD PAPER TO USE WFPA AS THE WW1-DEAD
lexical_split.right: WITHOUT SAYING WHY IT IS ONE, after PMID 25331887 and PMID 38499540. Here it is glossed only as 'a defect in the WW1 domain': no residue is named, and 'W44' and 'tryptophan' each occur zero times in the whole commentary. This corpus now holds the explanation from PMID 24308844 — W44 is the signature tryptophan whose indole forms the stacking platform for the ligand's P0, so WFPA removes the binding surface itself rather than perturbing it. The reagent has been load-bearing in three papers across eleven years and is explained in none of them. That is a reusable observation about this literature, not a criticism of this commentary: a control whose mechanism nobody restates is a control whose failure mode nobody can predict.

evidence.anchor: Section 'Alterations of WWOX in cancers support its role as a tumor suppressor', paragraph 1
evidence.snippet: Well-known tumor suppressors such as PTEN, RB1 and TP53 are significantly deleted (0, 7.24E−273 and 5.04E−22, respectively), although the deleted regions have additional genes within their peaks (i.e. PTEN with the tumor suppressor KLLN); WWOX, on the other hand, is a single gene within the deleted peak emphasizing that losing its own activity contributes to cancer

lexical_split.left: PRINCIPAL FINDING 2, PART B -- THE CALIBRATION SET UNDERCUTS THE INFERENCE IT IS OFFERED TO SUPPORT, AND THIS IS ARITHMETIC ON THE ARTICLE'S OWN PRINTED NUMBERS. Checked BOTH WAYS before being asserted. INTERNALLY COHERENT: by the quoted Q-values WWOX (1.31E-266) ranks below PTEN (0) and RB1 (7.24E-273), which is consistent with the claimed fifth place if two further unnamed loci also outrank it. BUT THE INFERENCE FAILS: TP53 -- the canonical tumour suppressor, offered here as calibration for what 'significantly deleted' means -- is quoted at 5.04E-22, some 244 orders of magnitude WEAKER than WWOX. If this metric ranked loci by tumour-suppressor importance, TP53 could not sit that far below WWOX. It does not: it ranks RECURRENT FOCAL DELETION, which is precisely what a common fragile site is expected to
lexical_split.right: whether or not the gene inside it is a driver. THE STATISTIC THEREFORE CANNOT DISCRIMINATE THE PASSIVE HYPOTHESIS FROM THE ACTIVE ONE, and it is the piece's leading evidence for the active one. The 'single gene within the deleted peak' argument is the one part of this paragraph that does bear on driver status, and it is a peak-width argument, not a Q-value argument.

Read literally, the dashed threshold line sits at about 0.83 on that axis, i.e. p around 0.15, and the most extreme point in either panel reaches about 1.4, i.e. p around 0.04 — meaning that across 9,404 and 9,318 variables not one gene would reach p<0.04. The Methods do not resolve it: they say significance came from the NOISeq-sim algorithm, and NOISeq's statistic is a PROBABILITY of differential expression whose conventional cut is 0.8, not a p-value — and 0.8 is almost exactly where the threshold line sits. So the axis is consistent with neither reading, and the Discussion's phrase 'significantly reduced expression' rests on a criterion that the paper does not let a reader reconstruct. A linear protein schematic numbered 1 to 414, blocks left to right: WW1 (orange), a yellow block with a yellow arrow labelled 'NLS', WW2 (green), a blue region, a teal block with a teal arrow labelled 'NADP', 'N' (blue), 'MTS' (orange to yellow), 'Loop' (grey), a red block with a red arrow labelled 'Catalytic Site', 'Central' (teal), 'C' (cream). A bracket underneath spans from the NADP region to the Central block, labelled 'SRD DOMAIN'. Variant lollipops above the bar include p.D16STer, p.E17K, p.W44Ter, p.P47R, p.R54Ter, p.G137E, p.H150P, p.H173Ter, p.Q230P, p.L239R, then p.R264Ter drawn in RED at the right-hand edge of MTS, then p.K297Ter, p.S304P, p.S318L, p.W335Ter. Horizontal arrows above mark 'Del exon 3-4', 'Del exons 1-6', 'Del exon 5', 'Del exons 6-8' and 'p.P203_R264del'.

lexical_split.left: 🔴 WHERE THE STOP CODON FALLS, READ OFF THE DOMAIN MAP, AND IT IS THE DETAIL THAT SEPARATES THE TWO ARMS. In panel 1G, p.R264Ter is drawn in red at the C-terminal boundary of the MTS
lexical_split.right: immediately before the grey 'Loop' and the red 'Catalytic Site'. So a truncation at residue 264 of 414 would RETAIN WW1, the NLS, WW2, the NADP site and the ENTIRE mitochondrial targeting sequence, and would remove only the loop, the catalytic site, the Central block and the C-terminus. INFERENZA: if the transcript escapes NMD, the product is not an absence of Wwox but a catalytically dead Wwox that can still be delivered to mitochondria and still present both WW domains to PPXY partners. Absence and a dead-but-present interactor are different diseases mechanistically and different problems therapeutically - one cannot be stabilised, the other might not want to be. The paper's disjunction hides this because both arms are called 'loss of normal function'.

lexical_split.right: GROUP UNDER A CONDITION THE PAPER NEVER SHOWS FOR THE MEASURES IT POOLS. The rule is declared and it is conditional. But Table 1 marks the heterozygote as significantly different from wild type on FOUR intrinsic properties — action-potential amplitude, input resistance, resting membrane potential and sag — and the S-CTL pooling is nonetheless used for the entire spontaneous-current analysis of Figure 4E-H. B: sleep profile in 30-minute bins across ZT0-24, grey w1118 and olive Wwox-f04545, dark phase shaded from ZT12; the grey trace shows a daytime siesta peak near 30 min per bin around ZT5-8 that the olive trace does not reach, and in the shaded night both traces sit near 30 min per bin until roughly ZT20 after which the GREY trace declines toward 20-25 while the olive stays at ceiling. lexical_split.left: 🔴 AND THE FIGURE'S OWN TITLE CLAIMS MORE THAN ITS PANEL D SUPPORTS. Figure 2 is titled 'Deletion of Wwox changed sleep duration WITHOUT AFFECTING THE CIRCADIAN RHYTHM', and the evidence offered for the second half is panel E: free-running period and rhythmicity are equivalent, 23.5 h and 96.9% against 96.7%. lexical_split.right: rises to roughly 100 beam counts per 30 min at ZT11-12 where the mutant reaches about 60 — while the morning peak is far more similar. In Drosophila that evening rise is anticipatory behaviour driven by the clock's evening oscillator, and IT CAN BE LOST WITH AN INTACT FREE-RUNNING PERIOD: period measures the pacemaker, anticipation measures its coupling to behaviour. INFERENZA: 'without affecting the circadian rhythm' is supported for the pacemaker and not for its output, and the two are different claims wearing one phrase. Panel B agrees — the night-time gain is not uniform but concentrated in the late night, where controls become active and mutants do not.

lexical_split.left: 🔴 THE
lexical_split.right: COHORT IS ROUGHLY TWENTY-FIVE TIMES TOO SMALL TO MEAN WHAT IT IS SAID TO MEAN, AND THE ARITHMETIC IS THE PAPER'S OWN. Absence in 100 healthy controls is offered as evidence of pathogenicity. The paper also reports the gnomAD allele frequency as 2.04e-4. One hundred people carry 200 alleles, so the EXPECTED NUMBER OF CARRIERS IN THAT COHORT IS 200 × 2.04e-4 = 0.04. Finding the variant absent is precisely what would happen for ANY variant this rare, pathogenic or benign — the observation has no power to discriminate. PREMISE_TAG: PREMISE: DEFAULT_FROM_TEXTBOOK — 'absent in controls means pathogenic' is the unstated rule, and it is false at this cohort size.
